Tracing raised to 1.0 on dc1 nodes then restored to 0.0 (verified). Keyspace dropped, snapshots cleared on all 6 nodes, Data API container removed.
target.working_set: memtable-resident; RF=3 means each write hits 3 replicas

probe1_A2.note: identical shredded layout as RF=1: 12 columns, 9 SAI indexes

probe2_FRESHNESS.note: RF=3 idle p50 45/28 ms and loaded p50 48/46 ms are ~2x the RF=1 figures (rh-hcd idle p50 25/19, loaded 42/42) — consistent with LOCAL_QUORUM writes now hitting 2 of 3 replicas. Run2 loaded p99 127ms / max 238ms shows a heavier tail under load than RF=1.

probe3_A3.reasoning: Update growth x1.72/x1.91 vs read growth x1.86/x1.85 — the pre-registered control rule fires (same slope) so the latency probe alone is INCONCLUSIVE, exactly as at RF=1. The cycle is established by trace (below), not the curve.

probe4_A5.MULTI_REPLICA_CONSENSUS_OBSERVED: YES — this is what RF=1 could not show. On RF=3, every conditional write executes a full Paxos round across all three dc1 replicas: coordinator sends PAXOS2_PREPARE_REQ to the other two replicas, both return 'Promising read/write ballot', coordinator reads existing values for the CAS precondition, then PAXOS2_PROPOSE_REQ to both, both 'Accepting proposal' + 'Appending to commitlog' + 'Adding to paxos memtable', then commit. Message sizes 370 B (prepare) to 263 KB (prepare-rsp with the read row) to 131 KB (propose with the new value).
probe4_A5.note: CL and serial-CL identical to RF=1 (LOCAL_QUORUM writes, LOCAL_SERIAL conditionals) — but now each is satisfied by 2 of 3 real replicas rather than 1. The conditional UPDATE's coordinator-side duration p50 is 13.7 ms; the non-conditional SELECT is 6.6 ms.
